dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Wait, this isn't Nasha Town...? But this is where the map said to go...

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Ah, Piramida, I know that name... *sigh* I've been getting lost left and right ever since I came to Nod-Krai... But I made it to Nod-Krai this time, didn't I? That's an improvement, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: In good news, there seems to be no shortage of things here that can serve as my research topics.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: And since we're already here, might as well stick around for a while and stock up on supplies before I head over to Nasha Town!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a researcher at the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Yes, I am a researcher from the Kshahrewar Darshan. They call me "Speedwalker Dzenana."

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: They probably just say it to tease me, but I'm not gonna lie, I kind of like that nickname.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Of course, being a researcher means I have to get out and broaden my horizons. I decided to visit Nasha Town this time because I heard there are all kinds of new and interesting mechanisms there!

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: But... I got lost and ended up here instead. Ha, it's just like my mentor said: "Dzenana, make sure you know which way you're going before you set out next time!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Okay. I should get back to my map...

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: I—I won? Haha, I'll take it, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Huh? I lost? Wait... Where exactly did things start to go wrong?
